title: I found military vehicles (like the one pictured) in underground garages.
content: It started with me walking through the mall. It might have been the food court because there were a ton of restaurants everywhere. I also remember a lot of neon signs but I don't remember what any of them said or even depicted. I made a turn into a hallway and then I was in a schoolroom. Another schoolroom. I'm getting tired of the schoolrooms. I had come in through a door that was in the corner of the room. Directly ahead of me, on the opposite side, was another door. There was a large window on the wall to the back of the room. It was just one long window with dark blinds on it. I walked over to it and looked out to see a bunch of smaller building. some looked white and other grey. I appeared to be maybe on the 3rd or 4th floor. Suddenly the room was filled with a bunch of people that appeared to be having a party. There wasn't any food, but everyone was holding red plastic cups and drinking. I spotted someone familiar from my former workplace. It was a woman I had become close to. She saw me and came up to me and we started a conversation. I don't remember what it was, but it ended up with me asking her out and she turned me down. That's when some guy said he had something to show us. So, we followed him out the other door. Just like that, we were in an underground area. We entered a garage that had about 4 of these military vehicles in them. Two were parked next to each other, two more behind them. There were weapons hanging on the walls around them. Guns, knives, and a lot more. I think we were actually on an elevator, along with the vehicles. I think I might have also asked the woman out again. Once more I was shot down. Then then man walked past our group, which seemed to be smaller now. He opened up a garage door and we were now on the ground floor. Actually outside. It was cold. We all suddenly had coats, jackets on us. They just appeared on us. I walked outside and found myself in a circular area. There were garages on all side. They were all closed at first, but they all opened up at once. There must have been about 6 of these garages in a circle, and all of them had 4 military vehicles inside. to one side there was a lone building. don't know what was in it but there were two guys with assault rifles on the roof. There was also a road to the right of the building that led out of this place. Incredibly tall palm trees grew on both sides of the road. Nothing but empty lands could be seen. Has anyone else seen vehicles like this anywhere in or outside of the mall or other buildings?
